main_body: Round wooden podium platform: a wide tan disc top with a short darker drum front below it. A small music stand with a sign stands on top.
top_band: Light tan elliptical top, rows ~13-25 (about 13 rows), with gold edge highlights at the rim and front edge around rows 24-26
evidence: Reading the middle column, a dark outline at row ~12 is followed by a large light tan top surface, then a gold highlight at the front edge (rows ~25-26), then the darker brown drum face down to row ~30. The top is clearly a horizontal surface seen from above, and the front face is a separate vertical band below it. The front face is short and has no eave shadow or recessed details, but the large elliptical top and distinct front face satisfy the 3/4 contract.

style.evidence: The outline is dark brown, matching the wood, which is fine. The top is a very large area of one or two flat tan tones with almost no grain, plank lines or speckle, well over 5x5 px of flat fill. The front face is likewise a flat brown block. The sign and stand are simple few-colour shapes. Many tiles carry only 2-4 colours, so it is much thinner than the stall and well references, which have tile scallops, stone-by-stone shading and wood grain.
